name: security-audit
description: End-to-end security auditing for web, API, mobile, wireless, cloud, code, secrets, dependencies, IaC, containers and LLM apps. Token-optimised attack-surface triage, deterministic CVSS scoring, live CVE/KEV/EPSS/ATT&CK intelligence, an authorization gate for intrusive testing, and professional Markdown/HTML/SARIF reporting.

nvd_api_key.title: NVD API key
nvd_api_key.description: Optional. A free NIST NVD API key raises the CVE lookup rate limit from 5 to 50 requests per 30 seconds. Request one at https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key

token_budget.title: Audit token budget
token_budget.description: Maximum tokens of source the attack-surface mapper selects for review in one pass. Lower is cheaper and shallower. The audit and report skills read this via ${user_config.token_budget}.
